article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike several terrorist positions and continue their offensive to secure the national territory
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent plusieurs positions terroristes et poursuivent leur offensive de sécurisation du territoire national
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely pursuing their mission of defending territorial integrity and protecting populations. As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, units engaged on the ground maintain sustained operational pressure against armed terrorist groups, through surveillance, intelligence, reconnaissance and targeted strikes The latest operations, conducted on 3 and 4 November 2026 in several sectors of the national territory, testify to the continuity of the military commitment and the willingness of the military authorities to leave no space for the terrorist threat .

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: in Soubo, a gold mine burned in retaliation for abuses against the Fulani, according to witnesses
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : à Soubo, une mine d’or incendiée en représailles aux exactions contre les Peuls, selon des témoins
article_manifest.summary: In a statement released on November 4, Human Rights Watch documented the September 1 JNIM attack on a gold mining site in northern Burkina Faso, which claimed the lives of 24 civilians.

article_manifest.title: Orpaillage interdit en Guinée : Bamako et Ouagadougou s'accordent pour le retour de leurs ressortissants
article_manifest.original_title: Orpaillage interdit en Guinée : Bamako et Ouagadougou s'accordent pour le retour de leurs ressortissants
article_manifest.summary: Des milliers d'orpailleurs maliens et burkinabè quittent la Guinée et refluent vers le Mali. Depuis la suspension de l'orpaillage artisanal décidée par les autorités guinéennes dans la zone de Siguiri, les localités maliennes frontalières voient arriver des convois de personnes contraintes de rentrer. Ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026, le Burkina Faso a dépêché une délégation ministérielle à Bamako, tandis que le Mali affirme avoir pris des dispositions pour accueillir et assister les personnes concernées.

article_manifest.title: Rejected gold miners from Guinea: the CNDH calls for the protection of migrants, especially children and young people
article_manifest.original_title: Orpailleurs refoulés de Guinée : la CNDH appelle à protéger les migrants, surtout les enfants et les jeunes
article_manifest.summary: The National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) is concerned about the arrival in Mali, since November 3, 2026, of many migrants mainly from gold mining sites in Guinea . In a communiqué published on 04 November 2026, the institution reminds the State of its obligations in terms of humanitarian assistance, based on the Malian Constitution and several international and African human rights protection texts.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Guinea: Ambassadors invited to a meeting in the context of operations in Siguiri
article_manifest.original_title: Guinée : les ambassadeurs conviés à une réunion dans le contexte des opérations à Siguiri
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, November 5 (AMAP) Guinean Foreign Minister Morissanda Kouyaté on Thursday invited heads of diplomatic missions accredited to Guinea to a meeting devoted to issues of common interest and the strengthening of international cooperation, in a context marked by the departure of foreign workers from the Siguiri region Announced in a statement dated 5 November, this meeting comes after the launch of operations against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in this region of the north-east of the country.

article_manifest.title: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara: the FAMa strike...
article_manifest.original_title: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara : les FAMa frappent...
article_manifest.summary: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara: the FAMa strike three terrorist positions in two days In a statement dated November 5, 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced two bases destroyed by precision strikes, near Koro and Sandaré, as well as a pair of terrorists on motorcycles targeted northwest of Sofara, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . The operations of surveillance, control and security of the territory continue.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Orpailleurs expulsés de Guinée : Au moins quatre morts et une centaine de malades
article_manifest.original_title: Orpailleurs expulsés de Guinée : Au moins quatre morts et une centaine de malades
article_manifest.summary: Kangaba, 5 novembre (AMAP)– Au moins quatre personnes ont perdu la vie et une centaine d’autres sont prises en charge au Centre de santé communautaire (CSCOM) de Kouremalé, parmi les milliers d’orpailleurs expulsés des sites d’exploitation aurifère de Siguiri, en Guinée. Certains des blessés soignés dans cette structure ont été atteints par des balles réelles.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Kouremalé : Les autorités du Faso saluent l’assistance «totale et inconditionnelle» à plus 40.000 orpailleurs burkinabè expulsés de Guinée
article_manifest.original_title: Kouremalé : Les autorités du Faso saluent l’assistance «totale et inconditionnelle» à plus 40.000 orpailleurs burkinabè expulsés de Guinée
article_manifest.summary: Kangaba, 5 novembre (AMAP) Les autorités maliennes ont mobilisé leurs services pour porter assistance à plus de 40.000 ressortissants burkinabè expulsés de sites d’orpaillage en Guinée et arrivés à Kouremalé, dans la commune rurale de Benkadi. Le conseiller à l’ambassade du Burkina Faso au Mali, Ramdé Antoine, et le délégué au Conseil des Burkinabè de la région de Koulikoro, Daouda Ouattara, ont salué l’assistance «totale et inconditionnelle» des autorités maliennes, particulièrement celles de Kouremalé, a constaté l’AMAP.

article_manifest.title: Mali: President Goïta endows several defence services with new rolling means
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : le président Goïta dote plusieurs services de la Défense de nouveaux moyens roulants
article_manifest.summary: On the sidelines of the commemoration of the National Day of Wards, this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Head of State, proceeded, at the Koulouba Palace, to the delivery of rolling means to several defense services .

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike terrorist bases near Koro, Sandaré and Sofara
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent des bases terroristes près de Koro, Sandaré et Sofara
article_manifest.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike terrorist bases near Koro, Sandaré and Sofara As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their allies continue to carry out missions to secure the country. The General Staff of the Armed Forces gave an update on several strikes carried out in recent days. On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, a terrorist base was spotted 52 kilometers northeast of Koro .

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces provides several defence services with new rolling means
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba : le Chef Suprême des Armées dote plusieurs services de la Défense de nouveaux moyens roulants
article_manifest.summary: Nine (9) buses and six (6) pick-ups were handed over by the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces to the Armed Forces Social Service, the Banankoro NCO School (ESO), the Military Police, the Directorate of Armed Forces Information and Public Relations (DIRPA), the Special Operations Command (COS), the Directorate of Military Sports, the Staff School, the Military Police and the Directorate of Armed Forces Music .

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: the President of the Transition offers vehicles to the Defence Services
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba : le Président de la Transition offre des véhicules aux services de la Défense
article_manifest.summary: On the occasion of the National Day of Wards this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, handed over nine buses and six pick-ups intended for the Defence Services, at the Koulouba Palace . These vehicles are intended in particular for the Social Service of the Armed Forces, the School of Non-Commissioned Officers of Banankoro, the Military Prytanée, the DIRPA, the Special Operations Command, the Military Police and the Directorate of the Music of the Armed Forces .

article_manifest.title: Des milliers de Burkinabè rapatriés de Guinée après des mesures contre l’orpaillage illégal
article_manifest.original_title: Des milliers de Burkinabè rapatriés de Guinée après des mesures contre l’orpaillage illégal
article_manifest.summary: Les mines d’or de Guinée attirent de nombreux ressortissants ouest-africains, notamment des Burkinabè. Mais lundi, le gouvernement guinéen a annoncé l’interdiction formelle de l’exploitation artisanale de l’or dans plusieurs zones du nord-est du pays, ainsi que le déploiement permanent des forces de défense et de sécurité pour faire respecter cette mesure. Les autorités guinéennes n’ont toutefois pas communiqué sur ces mouvements de population.

article_manifest.title: Rejected gold miners from Guinea: Mali and Burkina Faso organize the return of Burkinabe
article_manifest.original_title: Orpailleurs refoulés de Guinée : le Mali et le Burkina Faso organisent le retour des Burkinabè
article_manifest.summary: Rejected miners from Guinea: Mali and Burkina Faso organize the return of Burkinabe The Malian Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine, received on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 a Burkinabe delegation led by his counterpart, the Divisional Commissioner of Police Mahamadou Sana . The Burkinabe Minister of Family and Solidarity, Lieutenant-Colonel Passowendé Pélagie Kaboré, was also part of the delegation.

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: General Assimi GOÏTA hands over a batch of vehicles to several army departments
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba : Le Général Assimi GOÏTA remet un lot de véhicules à plusieurs services des Armées
article_manifest.summary: Koulouba: the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces endows several defense services with new rolling means On the sidelines of the commemoration of the National Day of Wards, this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, His Excellency Army General Assimi GOÏTA, Head of State, proceeded, at the Palace of Koulouba, to the delivery of rolling means to several defense services .

article_manifest.title: Withdrawal of driving licences: about forty files examined
article_manifest.original_title: Retrait des permis de conduire : une quarantaine de dossiers examinée
article_manifest.summary: La Direction générale des transports terrestres et maritimes (DGTTM) a tenu la troisième session foraine de la Commission technique spéciale de retrait du permis de conduire (CTSRPC), le lundi 26 octobre 2026, à la gare routière de Boromo. L’ouverture de la session de 48h a été présidée par le haut-commissaire de la province, Martin Bado, représentant le gouverneur de la région de Bankui.

article_manifest.title: Mali : Kouremalé face à l’afflux de milliers de personnes venues de la Guinée
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Kouremalé face à l’afflux de milliers de personnes venues de la Guinée
article_manifest.summary: La suspension de l’orpaillage artisanal dans la préfecture de Siguiri, en Guinée, provoque le retour forcé de milliers d’orpailleurs étrangers, notamment maliens et burkinabè. Face à cet afflux, les autorités annoncent des mesures pour accueillir les personnes concernées, leur apporter une assistance et faciliter leur retour dans leurs pays respectifs. Dans un communiqué publié ce mardi 3 novembre, le Centre de coordination et de gestion des crises (CECOGEC) assure que des dispositions sont prises pour assister les ressortissants concernés et organiser leur retour.

article_manifest.title: MILITARY COURT OF BAMAKO: eight cases considered at the correctional hearing
article_manifest.original_title: TRIBUNAL MILITAIRE DE BAMAKO : huit affaires examinées à l’audience correctionnelle
article_manifest.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at its headquarters located in Dar Salam, in the 3rd district of the District of Bamako, its ordinary correctional hearing. A total of eight (08) cases were on the docket, involving several military and civilian personnel for various acts relating to Military Justice. The hearing was presided over by Magistrate Assama DOLO, assisted by his colleagues .

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Hydrocarbons in Kayes: Resumption of supply
article_manifest.original_title: Hydrocarbures à Kayes : Reprise de l’approvisionnement
article_manifest.summary: Kayes, November 4 (AMAP)– Fuel supply has resumed normally in the Kayes Region after two days of disruption. A convoy of several tanker trucks arrived Tuesday, November 3 in the city, around 11 am, under the escort of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), announced the Regional Directorate of Trade . According to the Regional Director of Trade, Robo Bayo, this arrival has strengthened existing stocks at gas stations and outlets, ensuring continuity of supply throughout the region.

article_manifest.title: Image Africa Illegal gold panning: thousands of Burkinabe repatriated from Guinea
article_manifest.original_title: Image Afrique Orpaillage illégal: des milliers de Burkinabè rapatriés de Guinée
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso is organizing the repatriation of thousands of its nationals from Guinea from this week with the help of Mali, after the prohibition of artisanal gold mining in several areas of the north-east of the country. The Burkinabe Minister of Security is in Bamako on November 4. A sieve with gold glitter .

article_manifest.title: Presentation ceremony at the flag of the 2025 contingent of the FANs at the Aroungouza Training Centre in Zinder
article_manifest.original_title: Cérémonie de présentation au drapeau du Contingent 2025 des F.A.N. au Centre d’instruction d’ Aroungouza de Zinder
article_manifest.summary: Zinder, 04 Nov (ANP)- The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Maman Sani Kiaou chaired, Wednesday, November 4, the ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 2025 Contingent of the Niger Armed Forces (FAN) trained at the Aroungouza Instruction Center (about 15 km north of Zinder), in front of a large audience After several months of training, these new recruits have received the physical, technical and tactical skills necessary to accomplish their missions in the service of the nation In his speech, the Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Maman Sani Kiaou declared himself "honored to be in the…

article_manifest.title: Burkinabe returnees from Guinea: a government delegation on mission in Bamako
article_manifest.original_title: Burkinabè refoulés de Guinée : une délégation du gouvernement en mission à Bamako
article_manifest.summary: The Burkinabe Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana, visited Bamako on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 to inquire about the situation of several thousand compatriots returned from Guinea and to organize their return to Burkina Faso. Burkina Faso's Minister of Security, Police Divisional Commissioner Mahamadou Sana, was received on Wednesday in Bamako by his Malian counterpart, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine Mandated by President Ibrahim Traoré, he came to examine the conditions of care of young Burkinabe gold miners who arrived in Mali after their expulsion from Guinea, according to the Malian Armed Forces.

article_manifest.title: Chadian president meets Algerian foreign minister in Ndjamena
article_manifest.original_title: Chadian president meets Algerian foreign minister in Ndjamena
article_manifest.summary: Chadian President Mahamat Idriss Deby Itno on Tuesday met with Algerian Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf at the presidential palace in N'Djamena. The two countries discussed enhancing bilateral and the implementation of cooperation agreements signed during Deby's visit to Algiers last year. Observers say Algeria, which this week deployed troops to Niger seeks to regain influence in the Sahel.

article_manifest.title: Algeria prepares to launch Nigerian part of trans-Saharan gas pipeline
article_manifest.original_title: الجزائر تستعد لإطلاق الشطر النيجري من أنبوب الغاز العابر للصحراء
article_manifest.summary: Algerian diplomat: The completion of the Nigerian part of the trans-Saharan gas pipeline will start soon - Enhancing security and economic cooperation: Algeria strengthens cooperation with Niger to confront terrorist threats, and supports the re-establishment in Niger through training programs, which enhances the economic partnership after signing twenty cooperation agreements - Integrative projects and economic initiatives: Algeria supports African integration with projects such as the Trans-Saharan Road and a railway line towards Niamey, with a joint military agreement to enhance security and protect energy…

article_manifest.title: Military Court of Bamako: eight cases examined in correctional hearing
article_manifest.original_title: Tribunal militaire de Bamako : huit dossiers examinés en audience correctionnelle
article_manifest.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held its ordinary correctional hearing on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, under the chairmanship of Magistrate Assama Dolo. Eight files, involving military and civilians, were on the docket . The cases included acts of fraud, breach of trust, slanderous denunciation, loss of weapons, desertion, disobedience, escape of detainees and violation of military instructions.

article_manifest.title: Niger: after military support, Algeria launches mediation with Chad
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : après l'appui militaire, l'Algérie lance la médiation avec le Tchad
article_manifest.summary: Algeria is stepping up its involvement in the security challenges of the Sahel. After strengthening its military cooperation with Niger, Algiers now seems to favor the diplomatic route to bring Niamey and N’Djamena, whose relations are marked by tensions. It is certainly in this perspective that Ahmed Attaf, Algerian Minister of Foreign Affairs, paid a visit to Chad and then Niger Indeed, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, he went to N’Djamena as special envoy of President Abdelmadjid Tebboune where he was received by Chadian President Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Kouremalé faced with the influx of thousands of people from Guinea
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Kouremalé face à l’afflux de milliers de personnes venues de la Guinée
article_manifest.summary: The suspension of artisanal gold panning in Siguiri prefecture, Guinea, caused the forced return of thousands of foreign gold miners, including Malians and Burkinabe. Faced with this influx, the authorities announce measures to welcome the people concerned, provide them with assistance and facilitate their return to their respective countries In a statement issued on Tuesday, November 3, the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC) ensures that arrangements are made to assist the nationals concerned and organize their return.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Illegal gold panning: Hundreds of Africans driven from Guinea arrive in Bamako
article_manifest.original_title: Orpaillage illégal : Des centaines d’Africains chassés de la Guinée arrivent à Bamako
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP)– African nationals, mostly from a member country of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), arrive in Bamako after leaving gold mining sites in Guinea, following measures taken by the Guinean authorities against clandestine and illegal mining . At the Djicoroni-Para autogare, several of them are waiting to find the necessary means to return to Burkina Faso, AMAP noted.

article_manifest.title: HRW Demands Burkina Faso Govt Probe Civilian Killings
article_manifest.original_title: HRW Demands Burkina Faso Govt Probe Civilian Killings
article_manifest.summary: Human Rights Watch (HRW) has urged Burkinabe authorities to strengthen protections for vulnerable communities, investigate human rights abuses, and "fairly prosecute" those responsible following a wave of attacks by an Al-Qaeda-linked armed group that killed dozens of civilians. According to HRW, fighters from the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) attacked a gold mining site on September 1, killing 24 people.

article_manifest.title: Nouga: six Burkinabe gold miners die in the collapse of a gallery
article_manifest.original_title: Nouga : six orpailleurs burkinabè meurent dans l’effondrement d’une galerie
article_manifest.summary: Six people, all of Burkinabe nationality, lost their lives in the collapse of a mining well transformed into a gallery, on an isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou, in the rural commune of Nouga, in the circle of Kangaba . According to Essor, as soon as he was informed, the prefect of the circle went on site with the officials of the police, gendarmerie, national guard, civil protection and other technical services.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: South Africa: increased security for municipal elections
article_manifest.original_title: Afrique du Sud : dispositif de sécurité renforcé pour les élections municipales
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP) South African security forces have been placed on heightened alert for Wednesday's municipal elections, after 21 incidents recorded during the special vote, according to the National Joint Operations and Intelligence Structure (NATJOINTS) . Events reported on Monday and Tuesday include killings, theft of election materials, arson, intimidation and damage to campaign materials.

article_manifest.title: FIGHT AGAINST TERRORISM: THE AIR FORCE ANNIHILATES A TERRORIST GROUP NEAR GOURMA-RHAROUS
article_manifest.original_title: LUTTE CONTRE LE TERRORISME : L’ARMÉE DE L’AIR ANÉANTIT UN GROUPE TERRORISTE PRÈS DE GOURMA-RHAROUS
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) conducted three (03) aerial interventions resulting in four (04) strikes against positions of terrorist armed groups in the sectors of Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous The operations, carried out on November 2 and 3, 2026, (…)By Mahamane TOURE – NEW HORIZONRETROUVE the REST OF YOUR ARTICLE IN the NEW HORIZON OF WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 2026 Follow us on Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp to miss nothing of Malian news Follow us on Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp to miss nothing of Malian news

article_manifest.title: An Islamist armed group targeted civilians in Burkina Faso
article_manifest.original_title: Un groupe armé islamiste a ciblé des civils au Burkina Faso

article_manifest.title: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide of a mining well in Nouga Six people died last Friday in the landslide of a mining well, transformed into a gallery, in the rural commune of Nouga, precisely on a very isolated gold panning site in the village of Dioulafoundou.
article_manifest.original_title: Kangaba : Six morts dans l’éboulement d’un puits minier à Nouga Six personnes ont trouvé la mort, vendredi dernier, dans l’éboulement d’un puits minier, transformé en galerie, dans la Commune rurale de Nouga, précisément sur un site d’orpaillage très isolé du village de Dioulafoundou..
article_manifest.summary: The victims are all nationals of Burkina Faso According to our information, the people who died are all nationals of Burkina Faso. article_manifest.title: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous: the Noose is tightening around terrorist groups As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out airstrikes in different localities of our country between 2 and 3 November 2026.
article_manifest.original_title: Niono, Tessalit et Gourma-Rharous : l’Étau se resserre autour des groupes terroristes Dans le cadre de l’opération Dougoukoloko, les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa), appuyées par leurs partenaires, ont mené des frappes aériennes dans différentes localités de notre pays entre le 2 et le 3 novembre 2026..
article_manifest.summary: In a statement issued yesterday by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, it appears that on Monday, November 2, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, thirty kilometers east of Niono, a large base housing armed terrorist groups as well as war equipment, including armed vehicles. After confirming the collected information, the position has been processed successfully On the same day, twenty-eight kilometers south of Tessalit, a terrorist assembly point housing several individuals and war materiel was precisely spotted and struck.

article_manifest.title: 2nd coordination meeting of the military frequencies of the ESA countries: The work opened in Bamako The Minister of Communication, the Digital Economy and the Modernization of the Administration, Alhamdou Ag Ilyène, took part, on Monday, November 2, 2026, in Bamako, in the opening ceremony of the second coordination meeting of the military frequencies of the member countries of the Confederation of Sahel States (ESA).
article_manifest.original_title: 2è réunion de coordination des fréquences militaires des pays de l’AES : Les travaux ouverts à Bamako Le ministre de la Communication, de l’Économie numérique et de la Modernisation de l’Administration, Alhamdou Ag Ilyène, a pris part, le lundi 2 novembre 2026, à Bamako, à la cérémonie d’ouverture de la deuxième réunion de coordination des fréquences militaires des pays membres de la Confédération des États du Sahel (AES)..
article_manifest.summary: A view of the Presidium at the opening ceremony The ceremony was presided over by the Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence and Veterans Affairs, Major General Oumarou Diarra, in the presence of the President of the Telecommunications, Information and Communication Technologies and Posts Regulatory Authority of Mali (AMRTP), Saïdou Pona Sankaré . Organised by AMRTP from 2 to 4 November 2026, this strategic meeting aims to strengthen cooperation between Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger in the management and coordination of radio frequencies used by the Defence and Security Forces .
